decision.reason: [ev-177a6106bc02] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that HTTP/3 "moves outside the experimental section"; it does not say what happens to an environment that still sets the old experimental HTTP/3 option. The proposed "none" claims that existing HTTP/3 deployments keep working, and nothing in the evidence supports that. Moving a setting out of a section could also mean the old key is no longer honoured (setting-ignored). To decide, I need the v3 migration guide or PR #9570 to say whether the experimental.http3 option is still accepted, ignored or rejected, and whether HTTP/3 now has to be enabled somewhere else.
